universe.source: official point-in-time KODEX 200 top-30 PCF snapshots
universe.fundamentals: same-date official KRX KOSPI PER/PBR/BPS/EPS snapshot
universe.signal_timing: snapshot after close, first observable next KRX session, execute following session open

eligibility.price_confirmation: 12-minus-1-month return > 0 and split-adjusted close > split-adjusted 200-session average

execution.prices: split-adjusted histories for signals; exact-date official KRX all-stock closes for screening; complete official KRX daily actual closes for selected-name execution and integer sizing
execution.cash_distributions: include official payment events and applicable withholding for stocks and KODEX 200
execution.corporate_actions: fail closed if a selected holding crosses an unmodelled material actual-to-adjusted price scale change

pre_return_data_workflow_amendment.timing: after deriving candidate identities from the frozen rules and official decision-date cross-sections, but before any candidate return calculation
pre_return_data_workflow_amendment.unchanged: universe, score, eligibility, weights, timing, costs, pass gates, and sealed periods
pre_return_data_workflow_amendment.reason: full daily actual-price and distribution collection is required only for names the frozen rules can hold; screening every constituent from official all-stock decision-date cross-sections preserves the original selection rules
pre_return_data_workflow_amendment.selected_name_daily_data_rule: collect complete 2017-06-01 through 2022-12-29 KRX daily actual closes for every ticker selected at least once before calculating returns

decision_rule: Any development gate failure rejects v1 without opening either sealed period. Passing development opens only the 2023-2024 walk-forward period.
